# Isaiah Chapter 52 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 155r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ISA_052_page_001.jpg

---

**52:7** How beautiful [mah-na'vu] upon the-mountains [al he-harim] [are] the-feet [raglei] of-the-one-who-brings-good-news [mevasser], who-announces [mashmia] peace [shalom], who-brings-good-news [mevasser] of-good [tov], who-announces [mashmia] salvation [yeshu'ah], who-says to-Tsiyon, "Your-God [elohayikh] reigns [malakh]!"

**52:13** Behold, my-servant [avdi] will-prosper [yaskil]; he-will-be-high [yarum] and-lifted-up [venissa] and-very-exalted [vegavah me'od].

**52:14** As many [rabbim] were-appalled [shammu] at-you [alekha] — so marred [mishchat] was-his-appearance [mar'ehu] beyond-man [me-ish], and-his-form [veto'aro] beyond the-sons of-man [mi-benei adam] —

**52:15** so he-will-sprinkle [yazzeh] many [rabbim] nations [goyim]; kings [melakhim] will-shut [yiqpetsu] their-mouths [pihem] because-of-him; for what had-not been-told [suppar] to-them they-will-see [ra'u], and-what they-had-not heard [shame'u] they-will-understand [hitbonanu].
